claim: Instance-ID targets receive traffic on the primary private IP address of the primary network interface; IP targets can use any private IP address of any network interface, which lets several applications on one instance use the same port.
question: What is the advantage of registering targets by IP address instead of instance ID?

values.display: primary private IP address
applications on an instance to use the same port

evidence.quote: If you specify targets using an instance ID, traffic is routed to instances using the primary private IP address specified in the primary network interface for the instance. If you specify targets using IP addresses, you can route traffic to an instance using any private IP address from one or more network interfaces. This enables multiple applications on an instance to use the same port.

claim: With an HTTPS target group, the Application Load Balancer opens TLS connections to the targets with the certificates installed on the targets but does not validate them, so self-signed or expired certificates work.

claim: If an ALB target group contains only unhealthy targets, the load balancer routes requests to all of them regardless of health: when all targets fail health checks at once in all enabled Availability Zones, the load balancer fails open.

the load balancer fails open

evidence.quote: If a target group contains only unhealthy registered targets, the load balancer routes requests to all those targets, regardless of their health status. This means that if all targets fail health checks at the same time in all enabled Availability Zones, the load balancer fails open.

claim: If a Network Load Balancer's target groups have no healthy target in an enabled Availability Zone, the IP address for that subnet is removed from DNS; if all targets fail at the same time in all enabled zones, or the target group is empty, the load balancer fails open.

the load balancer fails open
when you have an empty target group

evidence.quote: If target groups don't have a healthy target in an enabled Availability Zone, we remove the IP address for the corresponding subnet from DNS so that requests cannot be routed to targets in that Availability Zone. If all targets fail health checks at the same time in all enabled Availability Zones, the load balancer fails open. Network Load Balancers will also fail open when you have an empty target group.

claim: With target group health DNS failover, when the healthy targets in a zone fall below the threshold, the load balancer node IP addresses for that zone are marked unhealthy in DNS, so clients are routed only to healthy zones.
question: What does the DNS failover setting of target group health do when a zone has too few healthy targets?

values.display: as unhealthy in DNS
routed only to healthy zones

qualifiers.scope: Application Load Balancer target group health
qualifiers.condition: healthy targets in a zone below the threshold

evidence.quote: **DNS failover** – When the healthy targets in a zone fall below the threshold, we mark the IP addresses of the load balancer node for the zone as unhealthy in DNS. Therefore, when clients resolve the load balancer DNS name, the traffic is routed only to healthy zones.

claim: With target group health routing failover, when the healthy targets in a zone fall below the threshold, the load balancer sends traffic to all targets available to that node, including unhealthy ones.
question: What does the routing failover setting of target group health do?

values.display: sends traffic to all targets
including unhealthy targets

qualifiers.scope: Application Load Balancer target group health
qualifiers.condition: healthy targets in a zone below the threshold

evidence.quote: **Routing failover** – When the healthy targets in a zone fall below the threshold, the load balancer sends traffic to all targets that are available to the load balancer node, including unhealthy targets.

claim: By default, a target group counts as healthy as long as it has at least one healthy target; you can instead set a minimum count or percentage of healthy targets.

values.display: at least one healthy target

evidence.quote: By default, a target group is considered healthy as long as it has at least one healthy target.
